name: Modular Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS)
function: Provides continuous conditioning and uninterruptible power backup to IT equipment in the server rooms.
location: Power Room 1 (2 Nos), Power room 2 (2 Nos)
maintenanceFrequency: Monthly visual & thermal check; Quarterly full diagnostic
commonFaults: Static bypass thyristor fault, cooling fan dust clogging, battery impedance degradation, DC link capacitor aging.
safetyPrecautions: Always isolate external DC battery breakers and discharge capacitors before opening panels. Use Arc Flash Category 3 PPE.

name: Weichai DCP1600kW Low-Voltage Container-type Diesel Generator
function: Continuous prime emergency generation in the event of total utility grid power blackouts.
maintenanceFrequency: Weekly no-load test; Monthly 50% load run; Annual resistive load-bank certification
commonFaults: Starter battery low charge, fuel oil contamination, jacket water pre-heater thermostat trip, fuel solenoid sticking.
safetyPrecautions: Hearing protection required inside acoustic enclosure. Ensure exhaust damper interlock is operational.

name: Cast Resin Dry-Type Step-Down Transformer
function: Steps down utility grid voltage from 11,000V (HT) to 415V/240V (LV) for data center critical distribution.
maintenanceFrequency: Quarterly thermal imaging; Bi-annual PT100 RTD sensor verification; Annual busbar torquing
commonFaults: Temperature controller trip due to dust accumulation on core ducts; Loose bus connections.
safetyPrecautions: Lock-Out Tag-Out (LOTO) on both primary 11kV breaker and secondary main LV incomer before cage entry.

name: Cast Resin Dry-Type Step-Down Transformer
function: Steps down utility grid voltage from 11,000V (HT) to 415V/240V (LV) for data center critical distribution.
maintenanceFrequency: Quarterly thermal imaging; Bi-annual PT100 RTD sensor verification; Annual busbar torquing
commonFaults: Temperature controller trip due to dust accumulation on core ducts; Loose bus connections.
safetyPrecautions: Lock-Out Tag-Out (LOTO) on both primary 11kV breaker and secondary main LV incomer before cage entry.

name: 11kV Medium voltage vacuum circuit breakers
function: High-voltage feeder protection, line isolation, utility grid incoming connection control & Interlocking for AVR bypass.
redundancy: Dual Incoming Supply Bus Coupler Scheme
maintenanceFrequency: Quarterly trip unit check; Annual vacuum bottle contact wear assessment
commonFaults: Spring charge motor mechanical fatigue, auxiliary contact oxidation, interlock misalignment.
safetyPrecautions: Do not rack breaker unless trip indicator confirms open. Grounding switch must be engaged before compartment entry.

name: Single Phase Step Voltage Regulator - AVR
function: The VR-8 Single Phase Step Voltage Regulator is a medium-voltage, tap-changing autotransformer designed to automatically regulate distribution line voltages.
maintenanceFrequency: Monthly visual inspection, quarterly cleaning, six-monthly terminal tightening, six-monthly electrical parameter checking, annual calibration, annual insulation testing, annual functional testing, preventive maintenance as per manufacturer recommendation
commonFaults: Overvoltage, undervoltage, output voltage fluctuation, hunting/oscillation, overheating, abnormal noise, input voltage failure, control circuit failure, sensing circuit failure, loose terminals, damaged brushes/contacts, worn components, blown fuse, communication/control failure
safetyPrecautions: Isolate power before maintenance, apply LOTO, verify absence of voltage, discharge stored energy, use proper PPE, use insulated tools, ensure proper earthing, do not bypass protection, avoid loose connections, maintain adequate ventilation, keep enclosure closed during operation, check for overheating, follow manufacturer instructions, perform testing by qualified personnel
relatedDocIds: SINGLE PHASE STEP VOTLAGE REGULATOR BROCHURE

name: Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) 3200A
function: Autonomous high-speed changeover between primary national grid supply and synchronized generator bus.
maintenanceFrequency: Quarterly mechanical transfer exercise under scheduled changeover window
commonFaults: Auxiliary contact bounce, neutral switch contact pitting, control board DC power supply ripple.
safetyPrecautions: Both sources (Mains & DG) carry lethal energy. Double-source isolation verification required.

name: Water-Cooled Centrifugal Chiller
function: Generates 7°C chilled water for the server hall CRAH and in-row precision cooling units.
redundancy: N+1 Redundant Array with fast-restart capacitor backup
maintenanceFrequency: Daily thermodynamic log; Monthly oil filter inspection; Bi-annual tube brushing
commonFaults: Condenser tube scaling causing high head pressure, oil return solenoid clogging, VSD cooling fan trip.
safetyPrecautions: Monitor refrigerant R-134a leak sensors before entering chiller plant pit.

name: In-Row Precision Air Conditioner (PAC)
function: Provides localized high-density thermal management within cold aisle containment racks.
location: Server Hall Rows A through F
maintenanceFrequency: Monthly synthetic air filter replacement and condensate drain flush
commonFaults: Condensate pump float switch stuck high, differential pressure sensor line plugged with dust.
safetyPrecautions: Rotating EC fan blades require isolation switch locked before intake grill removal.

name: Aspirating Smoke Detection System (VESDA)
function: Very early warning smoke detection via laser nephelometer chambers drawing air through perforated pipe arrays.
capacity: Coverage up to 20,000 sq ft across 4 pipes
location: White Space Racks & Return Air Plenums
maintenanceFrequency: Monthly airflow rate log; Quarterly smoke aerosol sensitivity test
commonFaults: Aspirator flow high/low alarm triggered by room pressurization changes, optical chamber dust contamination.
safetyPrecautions: Bypass fire alarm release interlocks prior to introducing aerosol test canisters.

name: FK-5-1-12 Gaseous Clean Agent Cylinder Bank
function: Total flooding gaseous suppression that rapidly absorbs heat without damaging electronic servers or leaving residue.
location: Dedicated Clean Agent Gas Cylinder Room
maintenanceFrequency: Monthly pressure gauge check; Bi-annual liquid level ultrasound reading
commonFaults: Slow pressure loss through manifold check valve, actuator lock-pin left in safe transport position.
safetyPrecautions: Insert manual actuator lock-pin before performing maintenance inside the server hall to prevent inadvertent discharge.

name: Intelligent Power Distribution Unit (PDU)
function: Sub-distributes conditioned power from UPS to individual rack power strips with branch circuit power metering.
redundancy: Dual PDU (A-Feed & B-Feed) per server row
maintenanceFrequency: Quarterly branch circuit current balance survey; Semi-annual IR thermography
commonFaults: Branch breaker trip on server power supply inrush, neutral harmonic heating.
safetyPrecautions: Verify branch breaker is open and tag out before pulling whip cables into server racks.
